air_switch_specification: Specification of grid side circuit breaker of storage system
battery_free_mode_tip: When turned on, it means that the inverter is on battery-free operation - i.e. regardless of whether there is battery access.
battery_ready_tip: Battery Ready function, turned off by default, please choose to turn on when there is no battery connected to the system or when the battery is not in use.
energy_empty_rule_tips: Please select according to the actual circuit breaker specifications on the grid side of the inverter. If the specification is incorrectly filled in, it may cause the circuit breaker to trip.
install_mode_tip: AC: refers to the photovoltaic transformation system, there is a photovoltaic inverter on site and on the power grid, and the photovoltaic module is connected to the photovoltaic inverter, not directly connected to the energy storage inverter; DC: For the site where the hybrid inverter is installed, it refers to the new photovoltaic system, and the photovoltaic modules are directly connected to the inverter; For the site where the battery inverter is installed, there is no photovoltaic inverter on site, the battery inverter is only integrated into the power grid, and only the power grid can charge the battery.Hybrid: This refers to a situation where there is a photovoltaic inverter connected to the grid on site, and photovoltaic modules are also directly connected to the hybrid inverter.
inv_pv_max_install_cap: PV Inverter Max. PV Installed Capacity
inverter_installed_capacity_tip: Total installed PV capacity connected to PV inverter
one_click_shut_down_tip: After this function is enabled, the system records the serial number on the cloud platform and marks it as lost, remotely locking the machine; The only way to unlock it is through Watery After-Sales, while users need to provide seller and invoice details, as well as paperwork proving the theft of the property. After the one-button shutdown is turned on, the PV input and battery charge and discharge will be automatically stopped, and the power cannot be taken from the grid to supply the load through AC bypass. Remote anti-theft, when the machine is lost, the serial number of the stolen machine can be fed back to the after-sales.
phase_sequence_adapt_tip: Before setting the adaptive phase sequence, please confirm whether the backup end is connected to a three-phase motor type load, otherwise it will affect the normal use of the load. For example, a water pump: The rotation direction of the water pump directly affects the direction of the water flow. If the phase sequence is reversed, the water pump may not be able to pump water normally. For example, a fan: The rotation direction of the fan is also affected by the phase sequence. If it is reversed, the air flow direction will be wrong. For example, lifting equipment: such as elevators, cranes, etc., they rely on the correct running direction of the motor. The wrong phase sequence may cause the equipment to operate incorrectly or in dangerous situations. For example, an air-conditioning compressor: The motor in the compressor is sensitive to the phase sequence. The wrong phase sequence may cause the compressor to reverse, affecting the cooling effect or damaging the equipment.
please_enter_multiple_sn: Please enter the SN encoding rule to support multiple selections
regional_application_standard_hint: Please select installation standard according to actual situation, only for Australia and New Zealand
remote_lock_tip: When this function is turned on, the device will be marked as lost, the device will be locked and stop working, the only way to unlock it is to contact Waters after-sales unlock after preparing the purchase invoice and stolen certificate.
safety_mismatch_hint: The current grid code does not match the device's country/region. Please verify.
shadow_scan_hint: This function is to reduce the influence of shadow and optimize the PV output
storage_pv_tips: Total installed PV capacity connected to energy storage inverter
three_unbalance_tips: For three-phase power grid areas without phase compensation, please turn on this function to support different power output of L1, L2 and L3 of inverter.
whether_cloud_self_inspection_is_support: Whether cloud self-test is supported during installation
whether_safety_selection_is_supported: Whether the installation safety regulation is supported
